<parameter=code>
def tile(f,r0,c0):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if L[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def show(s): return ''.join(''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in row) for row in s)
curB=[tile(current_frame,41,15+7*j) for j in range(5)]
prevB=[tile(previous_frame,41,15+7*j) for j in range(5)]
print("blue now == prev:", [a==b for a,b in zip(curB,prevB)])
# check blue row across last 8 history frames
for i in range(len(history)-8, len(history)):
    fr=history[i].frame
    b=[tile(fr,41,15+7*j) for j in range(5)]
    print(i, history[i].action, [show(s)[:5] for s in b])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tile(f,r0,c0):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if L[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def show(s): return '\n'.join(''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in row) for row in s)
# re-run cycle on slot 4 capturing raw symbols
def pink4(): return tile(current_frame,52,43)
seq=[pink4()]
for i in range(7):
    action(['UP'])
    seq.append(pink4())
# find unknowns (not T classes)
topc=[(5+9*i,c) for i in range(3) for c in (13,23,36,46)]
palette=[tile(current_frame,r,c) for r,c in topc]
def tr(s):
    t=[]
    for i in range(8):
        a=s
        for _ in range(i%4): a=tuple(tuple(a[r][4-c] for c in range(5)) for r in range(5))
        b=a if i<4 else tuple(a[4-r] for r in range(5))
        t.append(b)
    return t
def isT(sym):
    return any(sym in tr(p) for p in palette)
unk=[s for s in seq if not isT(s)]
for u in unk: print(show(u))
print("blue4:")
print(show(tile(current_frame,41,43)))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
